user.title: Home Assistant as a BACnet/IP device
user.description: Home Assistant joins the BACnet network as its own device. It uses this device to discover and read other BACnet devices, and to publish the entities you choose later.

data.foreign_bbmd: BBMD address for foreign device registration (optional)

data_description.interface: The prefix sets the broadcast address used for discovery, e.g. 192.168.1.50/24.
data_description.device_instance: Must be unique on the whole BACnet network (0 to 4194302).
data_description.foreign_bbmd: Leave empty when the BACnet devices are on the same subnet as Home Assistant. Otherwise enter the BBMD as IP or IP:port.

data.foreign_bbmd: BBMD address for foreign device registration (optional)

error.invalid_interface: Enter an IPv4 address with prefix, e.g. 192.168.1.50/24.
error.invalid_bbmd: Enter an IPv4 address, optionally with :port.
error.port_in_use: That UDP port is already in use on this address. Is another BACnet integration or add-on running?

abort.single_instance_allowed: BACnet Bridge is already set up.

menu_options.add_device: Discover and add a BACnet device
menu_options.expose: Publish Home Assistant entities over BACnet

add_device.title: Discover BACnet devices
add_device.description: Leave everything empty to broadcast Who-Is on the local subnet. Enter an IP address to ask one device directly.

pick_objects.title: Choose objects
pick_objects.description: {device} has {count} supported objects. Each chosen object becomes an entity; the recorder keeps its history.

data.writable: Allow Home Assistant to write to

expose.title: Publish entities over BACnet
expose.description: Sensors and binary sensors become read-only analog and binary inputs. Numbers become writable analog values; switches, input booleans, lights and fans become writable binary values.

data.write_priority: Priority for writes to commandable objects (1 = highest, 16 = lowest)

error.limits_pair: Enter both instance limits or neither.
error.discovery_failed: Discovery failed. Check the address and the logs.

abort.not_loaded: BACnet Bridge is not running. Check the logs, then try again.
abort.cannot_read_device: Could not read the device's object list.
abort.no_supported_objects: The device has no analog, binary or multi-state objects.
